resources.string: Closes the apps you choose, and hides the YouTube Shorts feed.

FocusForge watches which app comes to the foreground so it can close the ones you asked it to keep closed. To tell the YouTube Shorts player apart from a normal video — so lectures still play — it reads view names inside YouTube. It reads nothing else on screen: not your messages, not your passwords, and no other app at all. Nothing it reads is stored or sent anywhere.
A retro countdown and today’s completed focus time. Tap to open Focus.
